rowType.title: Row type
rowType.description: tender for a matching notice, summary for the single run summary row that every successful run writes. Filter on this field to keep only tenders.

buyer_name.title: Buyer
buyer_name.description: Name of the contracting organisation. Organisation only, never a person.

message.title: Run summary
message.description: Only on the summary row: how many notices were read from TED, how many matched the filters and how many were stored, in one sentence.
message.example: No tender matched: 120 notice(s) were read from TED and none of them matched your filters (CPV 45214200; countries FRA; minimum value EUR 0; keywords none).

criteria.title: Filters used
criteria.description: Only on the summary row: the CPV codes, countries, minimum value and keywords this run filtered with.
criteria.example: CPV 45000000; countries DEU, PRT; minimum value EUR 200000; keywords school

noticesRead.title: Notices read
noticesRead.description: Only on the summary row: how many notices TED answered before the filters were applied.

matchedNotices.title: Notices matched
matchedNotices.description: Only on the summary row: how many notices matched the filters.

storedNotices.title: Notices stored
storedNotices.description: Only on the summary row: how many tender rows this dataset holds.

chargedEvents.title: Charged events
chargedEvents.description: Only on the summary row: how many tender-matched events this run charged. The summary row itself charges nothing.

chargeLimitReached.title: Charge limit reached
chargeLimitReached.description: Only on the summary row: true when the run stopped early because the pay-per-event limit was spent.

chargeFailures.title: Charge failures
chargeFailures.description: Only on the summary row: charges that did not go through; the run finished anyway.

finishedAt.title: Finished at
finishedAt.description: Only on the summary row: when the run finished, in UTC.

overview.title: Matching tenders
overview.description: One row per matching TED notice, plus one summary row per run. Eight public fields only, no personal data.
